# linea-ui

> A lightweight CSS and JS component library built on BEM naming, an 8px vertical rhythm, and cascade layers. Readable class names, accessible defaults, and a small footprint.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://linea-ui.com/getting-started): Install linea-ui via npm, import the compiled CSS, and add the JS bundle.
- [BEM](https://linea-ui.com/getting-started/bem): How linea-ui uses Block Element Modifier naming.
- [Principles](https://linea-ui.com/getting-started/principles): The six design principles behind linea-ui.
- [Customization](https://linea-ui.com/getting-started/customization): Override SASS settings to tailor the library.
- [Vertical Rhythm](https://linea-ui.com/getting-started/vertical-rhythm): The 8px and 24px rhythm system.

## Foundation

- [Typography](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/typography): Type system built on a 24px rhythm grid.
- [Text](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/text): Utility classes for text styling.
- [Fonts](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/fonts): Font weight, style, and family utilities.
- [Theme](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/theme): Light and dark mode support.
- [Tables](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/tables): Table styling with striped rows and hover states.
- [Figures](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/figures): Figure and figcaption styling.
- [Media](https://linea-ui.com/foundation/media): Responsive images, video, and media objects.

## Layout

- [Grid](https://linea-ui.com/layout/grid): CSS Grid wrapper with configurable columns and gap.
- [Container](https://linea-ui.com/layout/container): Max-width wrapper for centred page content.
- [Section](https://linea-ui.com/layout/section): Full-width page bands with rhythm-based padding.
- [Cluster](https://linea-ui.com/layout/cluster): Flexbox row for inline groups of elements.
- [Breakpoints](https://linea-ui.com/layout/breakpoints): Five mobile-first responsive breakpoints.
- [Z-index](https://linea-ui.com/layout/z-index): Stacking order utilities and tokens.

## Components

- [Alert](https://linea-ui.com/components/alert): Contextual feedback messages with variants.
- [Badge](https://linea-ui.com/components/badge): Small status indicators and counters.
- [Breadcrumb](https://linea-ui.com/components/breadcrumb): Navigation breadcrumb trail.
- [Button](https://linea-ui.com/components/button): Buttons with four variants, three sizes, six colors.
- [Button Group](https://linea-ui.com/components/button-group): Grouped buttons with shared borders.
- [Divider](https://linea-ui.com/components/divider): Horizontal or vertical content separators.
- [Drawer](https://linea-ui.com/components/drawer): Sliding overlay panel.
- [Dropdown](https://linea-ui.com/components/dropdown): Toggleable overlay menu.
- [Empty State](https://linea-ui.com/components/empty-state): Placeholder for empty views.
- [Menu](https://linea-ui.com/components/menu): Vertical navigation list.
- [Modal](https://linea-ui.com/components/modal): Dialog overlay for focused content.
- [Navbar](https://linea-ui.com/components/navbar): Responsive top navigation bar.
- [Pagination](https://linea-ui.com/components/pagination): Page navigation controls.
- [Progress](https://linea-ui.com/components/progress): Horizontal progress bar.
- [Site Footer](https://linea-ui.com/components/site-footer): Structured page footer.
- [Skeleton](https://linea-ui.com/components/skeleton): Placeholder loading shapes.
- [Spinner](https://linea-ui.com/components/spinner): Animated loading indicator.
- [Steps](https://linea-ui.com/components/steps): Multi-step progress indicator.
- [Tabs](https://linea-ui.com/components/tabs): Tabbed content navigation.
- [Tag](https://linea-ui.com/components/tag): Small labels for categorization.
- [Toast](https://linea-ui.com/components/toast): Temporary notification messages.
- [Tooltip](https://linea-ui.com/components/tooltip): Hover/focus information overlay.

## Content

- [Accordion](https://linea-ui.com/content/accordion): Collapsible content panels.
- [Avatar](https://linea-ui.com/content/avatar): Circular image or initial placeholders.
- [Card](https://linea-ui.com/content/card): Flexible container for grouped content.
- [Code](https://linea-ui.com/content/code): Inline code and code block styling.
- [List](https://linea-ui.com/content/list): Styled list variants.
- [Meta](https://linea-ui.com/content/meta): Key-value metadata display.
- [Page Header](https://linea-ui.com/content/page-header): Structured page header block.
- [Prose](https://linea-ui.com/content/prose): Typographic wrapper for raw HTML content.
- [Quote](https://linea-ui.com/content/quote): Styled blockquote with citation.

## Forms

- [Choice](https://linea-ui.com/forms/choice): Custom checkboxes and radio buttons.
- [Field](https://linea-ui.com/forms/field): Form field wrapper with label and helpers.
- [Form](https://linea-ui.com/forms/form): Form layout patterns and validation.
- [Input Group](https://linea-ui.com/forms/input-group): Inputs with prepended/appended elements.

## Utilities

- [Background](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/background): Background color utilities.
- [Borders](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/borders): Border width, color, and radius utilities.
- [Colors](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/colors): Text color utilities.
- [Display](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/display): CSS display property utilities.
- [Flex](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/flex): Flexbox alignment and direction utilities.
- [Float](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/float): Float and clearfix utilities.
- [Opacity](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/opacity): Element opacity utilities.
- [Overflow](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/overflow): Overflow behaviour utilities.
- [Pointer Events](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/pointer-events): Pointer event toggling.
- [Position](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/position): CSS position property utilities.
- [Shadows](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/shadows): Box shadow elevation utilities.
- [Sizing](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/sizing): Width and height utilities.
- [Spacing](https://linea-ui.com/utilities/spacing): Margin and padding utilities.

## Patterns

- [Dashboard](https://linea-ui.com/patterns/dashboard): Full-page dashboard pattern.
- [E-commerce](https://linea-ui.com/patterns/ecommerce): Product listing and detail patterns.
